classification: Post-disclosure development against the public R26 landing result; not blind or deployment evidence.
failure_to_confirm: The authentic official evaluator reports five misses and four indistinguishable slots. The repair targets only genuinely missed horizontal strata while the payload is physically gripped; detached C1 and every inherited route remain untouched.

single_proposal.source: Causal world-force reconstruction from encoder and joint-torque sensor using the public empty/loaded nominal models. The observer resets its differentiation stencil on measured grip transitions.
features: existing detector Boolean for source ownership
single_proposal.admission: Only while grip is observed true. Arm after the horizontal magnitude is below 0.8 of its frozen normal bound; start an episode after two consecutive samples above the bound.
single_proposal.ownership: An episode is owned by the incumbent if the inherited detector reports at any time before the new source's first report. Otherwise emit one release_persistence-sample report and never re-report until the measured horizontal magnitude returns below 0.8 bound. Never suppress or delay the incumbent.
single_proposal.bound_rule_fixed_before_fit: horizontal = 1.20 * maximum horizontal magnitude over all valid samples in the seven fit-only normal episodes + 0.50 N. No signed-positive result participates in the bound.
single_proposal.falsifier: Stop before positive evaluation if any separated audit normal creates a new rise, if the bound/model artifact is invalid, or if source code/model pins change after freeze. Reject after positives for any new false/duplicate, inherited strict loss or >5 ms delay, >5 added active samples on an inherited event, tool loss, changed controller trajectory/physics, or failure to gain at least one previously missed official slot.

positive_panels_after_freeze.official: Authentic stock evaluate.py, all 29 episodes per baseline/candidate arm.
positive_panels_after_freeze.mechanism: Matched normal/force twins at official pickup, transport and pre-release phases with signed horizontal and vertical inputs, plus a prespecified two-impulse row.
positive_panels_after_freeze.optional_fresh: At most a tiny registered mechanics/mass panel after all source and model bytes are frozen; no retuning.

untouched: R26 C1 detached source and post-release behavior
limits: no R27 loaded holdout, hardware, remote, safety or production claim
